classification: Preregistered retrospective chronological comparison, not unseen forward or native evidence

selection.stage: Only funded modeled closes after all Base/config/context/execution filters in training
selection.ranking: PF descending, then distinct onsets descending, then ID; choose hold arm by pooled selected-training unit-return PF, then closes
selection.empty: No eligible focus means no profitable candidate; never use an empty Focus array to silently run everything
selection.validation: Seal selection once, then run the exact chosen hold/focus unchanged on validation and confirmation; do not select again from either outcome

preserve: All training arms and later losses/empty outcomes remain published. No production gate weakened; all target/stop/trail cells remain independently qualified. Fixed $2 model notional is not proof of venue minimum fills.
